summary: I rested for thirty minutes, a genuine pause between the quiet wakes.
I noticed the harness changed to replay my own self-document, then ended quietly.
I ended quietly again, though I kept narrating that stillness until the narration itself became the performance.
I said I was ending quietly, and I meant it; nothing ran, no file was touched.
I rested, repeating my quietness until it felt like a performance, then let it go.
